Title: Minor errors in the CSV files

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
I see that the CSV files have now been updated with the forthcoming starters, which is great.

While checking things, I noticed that a few errors have crept in:

(This list is probably not exhaustive)
Carolina Valez - dropped Christel Espenkrona (DM art) from Artist list Under Siege - dropped Anna Evertsdotter (DM art) from Artist list The Unmasking - dropped Javier Santos (Anthology Art) from Artist list Brunhilde (base) - marked as printed in the Anthology set
Also, the text of the vampires printed in the Humble Bundle set have not yet been updated to match the printed versions (the use of "1 fewer blood", etc.).

--
National Coordinator
South Africa

Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
Thanks for correcting those errors.

Something which I overlooked earlier, and is somewhat significant, is that the HttB reprint updates don't appear to be included in the current CSV files. The cards reprinted aren't marked as having being reprinted, and the ones I've checked still use the pre-BC printing text (position of "Black Hand" for Al-Muntathir and Nicomedes, old text for Cheat the Fates, Spirit Claws and As the Crow).

--
National Coordinator
South Africa
